holdout_reads_note: Holdout reads by this task, all rules: 1 (rule-1, mean-centred, after hashing; outputs/ncaaf/cfb_v62_report_rule1.md). The rule-2 fit and its ridge choice used train and validation only; the holdout was not re-read for selection. Before this task the holdout window's v6-vs-line numbers were read by the v6-espn check and the v6.1 comparison, so it is not clean.

rule.anchor_historical: ESPN pinned median of non-live providers (espn-lines-rule-1), closing, untimestamped
rule.anchor_serving: DraftKings line from the forward ESPN pregame capture, observed_at <= decision and < kickoff
rule.base: frozen cfb-structural-v6 (params sha256 6e38b14c...), calibrated margin and total; no refit
rule.blend: w = argmin sum (y - w*a - (1-w)*v)^2 on train, per market (margin, total); clipped to [0, 1]
rule.cohort: v6-covered lined events (cfb_v6_base_rows rows with a grid), season > 2016, both lines present
rule.margin_pmf: p(m) proportional to [Phi((m+.5-loc)/sd) - Phi((m-.5-loc)/sd)] * g(|m|), g(0)=0 (no ties in the data), g(k)=exp(theta_k) for 1<=k<=28 else 1; loc solved by 4 Newton steps: anchored rows cover-balanced at the anchor line (P(m > a) = P(m < a)); model-only rows mean-centred (E[m] = v6 mean)
rule.margin_sd: sd = exp(s0 + s1*|mu|/10 + s2*(anchor total - 55)/10), MLE jointly with theta on train
rule.metrics: validation: Brier/log (moneyline, cover, over), integer log score, key mass, cover near 3/7, MAE
rule.model_only_fallback: v6 means, v6 slice SD tables, same theta (no anchor at decision time)
rule.ridge: penalty lambda * sum(theta^2), lambda in [1.0, 10.0, 100.0] chosen by validation margin log score
rule.supersedes: cfb-v62-fit-rule-1 (mean-centred margin pmf). Changed AFTER rule-1's single holdout read: on train the mean-centred keyed pmf under-predicted favourite cover at half-point lines near key numbers (7.5: 45.0% predicted vs 57.6% actual, n 144), so the anchored pmf is now centred cover-balanced at the anchor line. The holdout is NOT re-read under rule-2.
rule.total_pmf: discretised normal at the blended total mean, sd per anchor-total bucket [[0.0, 45.0], [45.0, 52.0], [52.0, 60.0], [60.0, 999.0]], MLE on train

windows.holdout: date > 2024-11-14, scored at most once after the artifact is hashed
